title: Settings
description: Workspace, users and system information. Credentials are managed exclusively via environment variables (see .env.example).

users.title: Users & roles
users.note: The multi-tenant data model is fully in place (workspace isolation across all tables). A real login/auth interface with multiple users is the next build step — for now the app runs on this single default workspace.

system.title: System
system.dbNote: Database: SQLite (local, prisma/dev.db) via Prisma ORM. For production, switch DATABASE_URL to Postgres/MySQL (adjust the provider in prisma/schema.prisma).

onboarding.title: Setup assistant
onboarding.description: The small step-by-step windows for AI providers, social platforms and voice output that appear the first time you open the app.
